lines: Title: Operation on Set for which Every Equivalence Relation is Congruence
Let $S$ be a [[Definition:Set|set]] with at least $3$ [[Definition:Element|elements]].

Let $\circ$ be an [[Definition:Binary Operation|operation]] on $S$ such that every [[Definition:Equivalence Relation|equivalence relation]] on $S$ is a [[Definition:Congruence Relation|congruence relation]] for $\circ$.
Then $\circ$ is one of the following:
:the [[Definition:Constant Operation|constant operation]] $\sqbrk c$ for some $c \in S$.
:[[Equivalence Relation is Congruence for Constant Operation]]
:[[Equivalence Relation is Congruence for Left Operation]]
:[[Equivalence Relation is Congruence for Right Operation]]

every [[Definition:Equivalence Relation|equivalence relation]] on $S$ is a [[Definition:Congruence Relation|congruence relation]] for the [[Definition:Right Operation|right operation]], the [[Definition:Left Operation|left operation]] and the [[Definition:Constant Operation|constant operation]].
Let $\circ$ be an [[Definition:Binary Operation|operation]] on $S$ which is ''not'' one of those three.
